reason: The hypothesis directly restates the exact intervention, mechanism, and quantitative outcomes from a single paper (P13-P16, P19) that already demonstrated the effect of serrated grain boundaries on tensile and creep properties of a precipitation-strengthened HEA. It proposes no new material, regime, or mechanistic insight beyond what that paper reported as a result.
copied_elements: slower cooling rate during solution heat treatment to induce serrated grain boundaries
serrated grain boundaries reduce local strain concentration and impede intergranular crack propagation
increase in tensile fracture strain by a factor of 3.5
reduction in minimum creep strain rate by 96%
application to HEAs for extreme environments (650°C to 982°C)
